desc:
Raise, train, evolve, and master your own dragons across a world of floating islands.
Choose your first dragon, train its Strength and Speed, evolve from Baby → Teen → Adult → Titan, then unlock new abilities like gliding, full flight, elemental attacks, and riding.
Explore new islands, discover rare eggs, race powerful guardian dragons, mine valuable ores with your dragon, upgrade your tools, and build a growing collection of elemental dragons.
Features
- 🐉 Raise and evolve multiple dragons
- 🔥 Choose elemental dragons like Fire, Water, Lava, and Ice
- 🏁 Train Speed through courses, gliding, and races
- 💪 Train Strength through dragon abilities and challenges
- ☁️ Fly between floating islands
- 🥚 Discover and hatch new dragon eggs
- ⚔️ Take on unique island Guardian challenges
- ⛏️ Mine rare ores with your dragon and upgrade your pickaxe
- 🏡 Display dragons at your personal plot
- ✨ Find rare Shiny dragon variants
